column22:
Column F lists content that has been definitively and negatively moderated after being detected by Dailymotion, on a global scale, during the reporting period. These decisions include all content types (video, avatar, account, comment, chatroom) and all types of negative moderation actions: removal, deactivation, demonetization, age restriction, and geo-blocking.
Important note: This data represents the total number of definitive negative moderation actions taken by Dailymotion, not the number of unique content whose access or visibility was effectively restricted. Since multiple moderation actions can be applied to the same content, this figure may be higher than the actual number of restricted content items. This metric tracks all negative moderation decisions regardless of the final status of the content.
column23: Includes all the definitive and negative moderation decisions taken on all types of content after being detected by at least one of our automated detection tools (see cell E4 in tab 11 - Qualitative).
column24: Includes all the definitive and negative moderation decisions taken on content after a detection by Dailymotion that resulted in its removal.

column29: When Dailymotion applies a sensitive filter action, a warning message is displayed in the video player to inform viewers that the content might not be suitable for all audiences. This metric reflects the number of videos where such a warning is displayed as a result of definitive and negative moderation actions taken proactively by Dailymotion.
column30: Includes all the definitive and negative moderation decisions taken on content that resulted in the content being geo-blocked.

column37: Account deactivations occur exclusively under our repeated infringer policy, following video removals due to serious and/or repeated policy violations.

column5:
In this category, we list the notifications (i.e., user or trusted flagger reports) and sanctions (i.e., negative moderation decisions) that fall under our  “Child abuse” policy. 
We define child abuse as any behavior, action, or content that depicts, promotes, glorifies, or trivializes the physical, emotional, or psychological harm, neglect, or exploitation of children (individuals under 18 years old). This includes (1) Child labor, (2) Glorification or mockery, (3) Hoaxes, pranks, and dangerous challenges, (4) Bullying.
In this category, we list various types of sanctions (i.e. negative moderation decisions) such as demonetization, restriction of social features, and removal of avatars.
column22:
Column F lists all definitive and negative moderation decisions that affected content visibility but are not included in the above categories. This includes actions such as demonetization, private videos, and visibility restrictions applied to comments following detection by Dailymotion. This also includes actions related to the repeated infringer policy. 
Note: Comment moderation does not yet have censor reason granularity (work in progress). As a result, all comment removals are currently listed in this category regardless of the specific reason for removal.
